purpose: Five fictional transaction scripts for an initial live Gnani check. These are scripts, not audio recordings or completed experiments.
recording_instructions: Use fictional materials, quantities and prices only. Do not record customers or identifiers.
Read each script into a short WAV file (30 seconds maximum); save to the declared wav path or update it.
Change audio_provenance from unrecorded to human_read_fictional_prompt or tts_generated only after making the file. Human speech and generated speech must stay distinguishable.
Label conditions accurately. The initial clean recordings do not establish performance on noisy real telephony.
Have a fluent Kannada speaker verify what was actually spoken and the intended numbers. The gold values below describe fictional intended transactions.
Run with --limit 1 first. There are no automatic retries. Optional --tts adds separate synthesis calls.

clips.condition: clean prompt; actual recording condition to be supplied
clips.prompt: ಕಾಗದ, ಒಟ್ಟು ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೈದು ಕೆಜಿ, ಚೀಲ ಎರಡು ಕೆಜಿ, ದರ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೆಜಿ

clips.condition: decimal and half; actual recording condition to be supplied
clips.prompt: ಕಾಗದ, ಒಟ್ಟು ೧೨.೫ ಕೆಜಿ, ಚೀಲ ಅರ್ಧ ಕೆಜಿ, ದರ ಹದಿನಾಲ್ಕು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೆಜಿ

clips.condition: fifteen/fifty confusion target; actual recording condition to be supplied
clips.prompt: Iron, gross twenty five kg, tare two kg, rate fifteen rupees per kg.

clips.condition: code-mixed correction; actual recording condition to be supplied
clips.prompt: ಕಬ್ಬಿಣ, gross twenty five kg, tare two kg, rate fifty rupees per kg ಅಲ್ಲ fifteen rupees per kg.
clips.note: Intended rate is 15 after correction. Conservative parser may retain the earlier candidate 50 and block; report that mismatch openly, then test explicit human correction separately.

clips.condition: missing unit; actual recording condition to be supplied
clips.prompt: Paper, gross twenty five kg, tare two kg, rate twenty.
